description_en: Queries the details of a namespace
description_zh: 调用DescribeNamespace接口查询命名空间详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun sae describe-namespace --namespace-id cn-beijing:test --name-space-short-id test --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeNamespace

parameters.description_en: The ID of the namespace. The information about the default namespace cannot be queried or modified. The default namespace cannot be deleted.
parameters.description_zh: 命名空间ID。默认命名空间不可查询、更改或删除。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the namespace. The information about the default namespace cannot be queried or modified. The default namespace cannot be deleted
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间ID。默认命名空间不可查询、更改或删除
parameters.name: namespace_id

parameters.description_en: The short ID of the namespace. You do not need to specify a region ID. The value of this parameter can be up to 20 characters in length and can contain only lowercase letters and digits.
parameters.description_zh: 短版命名空间ID，不需要带上region；不超过20个字符，仅允许小写英文字母和数字。
